ModMetaData.name: Concord Waylith RimWorld Probe
ModMetaData.author: CryptikLemur
ModMetaData.description: Integration probe for the Concord body-replacement backend on RimWorld. Installs the backend, patches a mod method and a real game method through Concord, and measures what happens when Harmony and Concord share a process and a method. Prints an [RPROBE] report to stdout. Not for players.
